title: CreatedMoves
description: The plugin of moves as written into Mod Mallet's own folder.

light.description: Whether it is flagged as light.

masters.description:
The plugins it names as masters: those whose versions it copies
and those they refer to. It loads after them.

path.description: The archive that holds it, ready for the mod manager.

refused.description: The objects it could not move, and why.

MoveRefusal.description: Why an object could not be moved by the plugin.

oneOf.description: No active plugin places it where it was said to be.
The version the game uses deletes it or switches it off.

The object, its cell or its worldspace has a field Mod Mallet does
not know how to copy; copying it blindly could break what it
refers to.

field.description: The record type and the field, such as `REFR XCVL`.

oneOf.description: A name the game keeps in a string table could not be found there.
The game is not one whose plugins Mod Mallet can write.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.

RefusedMove.description: An object that was not moved, and why.
